primary_evaluation: 3849 matching-heldout images; 39 development images excluded from head fitting and scoring
outer_splits: Existing 12 shape folds and 12 illumination folds; each outer tiny checkpoint only trained on other 33 groups
tiny: Independent single-kernel control, lr .01, terminal epoch30, two-seed mean; not exact author network
calibration: Fixed ordinary least squares with intercept, predictors standardized on outer training rows. Tiny training predictions from the SAME outer checkpoint. They are in-sample to the tiny learner; no nested stacking claim. Outer test labels never used for base learner or calibration.
comparisons: tiny linear vs tiny linear + InternVL
tiny cubic vs tiny cubic + InternVL
physical/color/viewpoint controls + tiny cubic vs same + InternVL
InternVL alone calibrated on same outer train
controls: 50 physical c categories, categorical viewpoint and chroma, sin/cos hue harmonics 1 and 2; no shape or illumination identity predictors
uncertainty: 4000 paired condition-cluster bootstrap replicates for loss reduction, separate shape and illumination clustering plus two-way crossed weighting. Fixed predictions; not full retraining uncertainty.
author_supplement: Released author predictions used only for descriptive residual correlations, unknown exact fold membership.
inference: No new InternVL collection, no new tiny training, only frozen tiny checkpoint inference
